name: SiftingIO
description: Real-time and historical market data for US stocks and ETFs, forex, commodities and crypto over REST, with real-time WebSocket streams and Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs. A usage-limited free plan is available for individual, internal non-commercial use.

auth.notes: Requires a SiftingIO account and API key sent in the X-API-Key header. Free-plan usage limits and licence restrictions apply; see https://sifting.io/pricing.

endpoints.description: Historical forex OHLC bars for a currency pair. Requires an API key in X-API-Key, Accept-Encoding: gzip, and the documented date-range parameters.
